personal.name: Pritesh Vadhel
personal.title: Principal Software Engineer – AI & Automation
personal.subtext: Principal Software Engineer specializing in AI & Automation. I architect mission-critical systems that handle millions in transactions, combining resilient .NET/AWS infrastructure with agentic LLM routing and autonomous workflows. Building systems that can't go down, can't lose data, and can't afford to be slow.
bio: I build high-scale products, distributed backends, and autonomous workflows across enterprise data, cloud infrastructure, and AI. Over the last 15+ years, my career has centered on mission-critical reliability—where milliseconds matter and downtime carries immediate enterprise consequences.

Today, I focus on the intersection of deterministic systems and generative AI: orchestrating agentic LLM pipelines, real-time telephony routers (Asterisk SBC), and cloud-native microservices on AWS and .NET 10.

I believe the highest-leverage software isn't just about calling an API—it is built by engineers who understand the entire stack beneath it: from query execution plans and Always On cluster failovers to multi-agent state machines.

history.title: The Relational Foundation
history.detail: Deep dive into query execution planners, clustered index mechanics, and multi-terabyte schema design. Learned firsthand that every single disk I/O hop compounds at scale.

history.title: High-Throughput Distributed Backends
history.detail: Engineered .NET Core microservices, high-availability Always On clusters, and payment pipelines powering millions in automated transactions with strict 99.9% SLAs.

history.title: Agentic AI & Production Automation
history.detail: Building deterministic context routers, autonomous LLM agent networks (agency-agents), and Asterisk-to-Voice-AI session controllers operating in real time.

experience.description: Architected a Propensity Architecture utilizing local ML inference for compliance risk. Re-architected Asterisk PBX environment for near-100% uptime. Built serverless AWS data pipelines (Lambda + SQS + API Gateway) for real-time financial transactions at scale. Shipped a unified omni-channel messaging platform replacing hardcoded logic with a DB-driven engine.

Worked on-site at Trustmark Benefits, a national leader in employee benefit administration. Contributed to systems delivering cost-effective benefit solutions across diverse client bases including self-funded employers and state high-risk pools.

Developed and managed applications for a Fuel Card System processing credit, debit, and gift card transactions. Handled top-level and sub-level customer hierarchies for authorized fuel site purchases.
Engineered Utility Bill Management (UBM) systems to transform raw utility data into centralized operational metrics. Facilitated carbon footprint calculations and global portfolio tracking.
Developed modules including database design, backend code, report generation, web hosting, and testing.
